info.name: Services - Provider & Admin
info.description:
Services module APIs.

**Provider (user):** Provider profile, service categories list, service offers CRUD.
Set `base_url` and `access_token`.

**Admin:** Providers (list, show), Service categories CRUD + toggle status.
Set `base_url_admin` and `access_token_admin`.
